abort_conditions: PREFLIGHT (before any Trn2 run): the resolved startup config/log must show local-conv enabled in the default model and the NKI local-conv path selected when --nki-local-conv is passed, and the compiled two-tap path selected in the control. If the flag resolves as already-on in the control, or local-conv is disabled by default, the experiment is a no-op: do not run, record as NOT-RUNNABLE.

PREFLIGHT: the controller environment lacks NKI_VENV_PATH (all fs NKI runs set NKI_VENV_PATH=/home/ubuntu/workspace/native_venv). If train.py at 9a4caa7b cannot dispatch the NKI kernel under the fixed controller environment (raises, or logs a fallback to the compiled conv), classify INVALID / NOT-RUNNABLE, not falsified; do not add env variables as part of this proposal.

INVALID (precedence 1): crash, non-finite loss at any logged step, causality_passed != true, no final checkpoint, git dirty, or any environment/launch difference from the same-host control other than the single flag (--num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42, CC exactly '--optlevel=1', LNC=2, nproc 4 must all match).

SMOKE GATE (300 s, same host as its control smoke): do not promote to full if smoke steps <= 335 (no throughput gain over 334/335) or if loss at matched step counts deviates from the control smoke by more than 0.02 nats in the same direction for the last 100 logged steps (kernel non-equivalence). Smoke steps in 336-344 promote only with a note that the predeclared +3% was missed.

FALSIFIED (precedence 2, valid full run): completed steps <= same-host control steps (2071 trn21 / 2076 trn22) — throughput prediction failed regardless of bpb — OR public_val_bpb >= control bpb - 0.001.
SUCCESS (precedence 3): valid full run with steps >= 1.05x same-host control steps AND public_val_bpb <= control bpb - 0.003.

INCONCLUSIVE (precedence 4, exhaustive remainder): valid full run with steps > control and bpb < control - 0.001 but failing either SUCCESS threshold; record, do not adopt, do not repeat without a new hypothesis.

Budget accounting: report training_seconds and startup allowance explicitly; if NKI kernel compilation is charged against the budget per README.md and cannot be separated, state that in the record rather than reinterpreting the step count.

expected_effect: Direction: public val_bpb decreases relative to the same-host control purely through more optimizer steps in 1800 s. Predeclared sizes: smoke (300 s) steps >= 345 vs 334/335 control (>= +3%); full run steps >= 2175 vs 2071/2076 (>= +5%), public_val_bpb <= control - 0.003 (i.e. <= 1.0027 on trn21 / <= 1.0030 on trn22). If the conv is not a bottleneck at this shape the effect is null (steps within +/-1% of control, bpb within +/-0.001). Per-step loss trajectory at matched step counts is expected to overlay the control within seed noise because the kernel is numerically gated; a per-step divergence would indicate the kernel is not equivalent at this shape. Public val_bpb is the controller's proxy; official private-shard BPB shares the scoring function but not the data.
hypothesis: At the pinned default shape (6 layers, 592.9M params incl. 4x1M-row BF16 n-gram tables, FP32 matmul, CC='--optlevel=1'), the compiled two-tap local convolution is a non-trivial fraction of the ~0.87 s/step budget (2071-2076 steps in 1800 s). Replacing it with the already-integrated, gate-validated fused NKI local-conv kernel (--nki-local-conv), which is designed to be numerically equivalent to the compiled conv ('corrected integration passed all four native gates', fs-w12), will raise completed steps in the fixed 1800 s budget and therefore lower public val_bpb, with no change to the model function, optimizer, schedule, precision boundaries (FP32 norm outputs and residuals retained, exactly as fs-w15 demonstrated NKI conv works with FP32 normalization), data, or evaluator. This is the isolated arm the proposal verifier explicitly requested when rejecting the bundled --nki-local-conv+--bf16-norm-output proposal ('Test --nki-local-conv alone against defaults').
single_causal_change: Pass --nki-local-conv only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: no --bf16-norm-output, no --bf16-sdpa-input, no --compile-sdpa-direct, no optimizer/clipping/schedule/shape/precision switch, no env change (NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1', NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, nproc 4, --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42). The only behavioral delta is which implementation computes the same two-tap local convolution (fused NKI kernel instead of the compiled PyTorch two-tap path). Inference on the control default: neither pinned control launch passes --nki-local-conv; every fresh-start run that used the kernel (fs-w9, fs-w12, fs-w14, fs-w15, fs-w16, fs-w18, fs-w50..fs-w146, commits 2026-09-18..19) passed it explicitly, and the paired --no-nki-local-conv flag exists, so the default is off; preflight MUST confirm this from the resolved-config/log line printed at startup (see abort conditions) rather than assume it.
